_about: Public-domain Aleksei Khomiakov (1804-1860, Russian lay theologian) in English for the Word Hoard: The Orthodox Doctrine on the Church, translated from the Russian (Brussels, 1864), and Russia and the English Church, vol. I, his correspondence with William Palmer (1844-1854) with Birkbeck's translation of his essay The Church is One, edited by W. J. Birkbeck (London: Rivington, Percival, 1895), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
